editorial:
If you love monsters, magic, and a hero who looks like he came straight from a comic book, this movie is a blast. Hellboy is a big red demon with a heart of gold who works for a secret government team that fights weird creatures. Alongside his fiery girlfriend Liz and his fish-like friend Abe, he faces an angry elf prince who wants to take back the world for fantasy beings. The movie feels like a dark fairy tale mixed with an action comedy, packed with wild creatures and colorful sets that make every scene pop.

The action scenes are fast and fun, and the creature designs are amazing, especially the giant troll market and the golden robots. Ron Perlman is perfect as Hellboy, bringing humor and heart to a grumpy hero. The story can feel a bit busy at times, and some jokes land better than others, but the visuals and energy keep you hooked. If you enjoy fantasy adventures with a sense of humor, you should definitely check it out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Hellboy fights Prince Nuada for control of the Golden Army. After a tense duel, Hellboy kills Nuada, but the prince warns that the army will always be a threat. Hellboy then destroys the crown that controls the robots, shutting them down forever. Liz reveals she is pregnant, and Hellboy decides to leave the government agency to start a family, choosing love over duty.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fantasy adventures with humor and wild creature designs.
